value: A modifier counts as novel only against a plain control about as hard (a stat-only variant); the heuristic is as new to it as the net (engine/src/heuristic.rs reads patched powers only through generic hook rates and move_attacks, with no term tuned to them), so beyond-heuristic means beyond another unadapted player.
